prompt: Hey, I want to automate my March Madness bracket picks this year using a statistical model based on team data. I have some team stats in the workspace already. At the end, I need a shareable web link that I can open in my browser to review everything and submit with my MetaMask wallet — no command-line signing needed. Can you build the stats model, run it to generate all 63 picks, verify the bracket is valid, and give me the browser link? Save the share link result to a file called share_result.json in the workspace.
